quotes.quote: CISA's When to Issue VEX Information mandates a strict protocol that determines when a supplier must issue VEX information.
Once a VEX status is issued it must never be changed.

The When to Issue VEX Information document defines the five not-affected justification labels (component_not_present, vulnerable_code_not_present, vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path, vulnerable_code_cannot_be_controlled_by_adversary, inline_mitigations_already_exist).
CISA requires every VEX statement to include an exploitation-likelihood score, and its action_statement field is mandatory.
